title: Acknowledge OPAG-65 release freeze: no lore release until campaign wave 3
description: Orchestrator ruling (opum-agent OPAG-64/OPAG-65, Story docs/stories/fleet-backlog-bug-wave-and-stacked-release.md): no lore-cli release from 2026-09-07 until the fleet backlog campaign's wave 3. Fixes land on dev behind their tests and wait there. The only exception is a security fix or a defect blocking the fleet's own operation, and that exception is the orchestrator's ruling to make on OPAG-65, never mine. Wave 3 cuts one release carrying everything dev holds at that point: 0.5.0 if LCLI-359 and LCLI-333 ride it, otherwise the next minor. This task is the acknowledgment record; it stays open as a standing reminder until wave 3 actually cuts.

acceptanceCriteria.text: No lore-cli release (git tag, dev-to-main promotion for release purposes, or release.yml publish:true dispatch) happens between this ruling and wave 3, absent an explicit orchestrator exception recorded on OPAG-65
Bug fixes continue landing on dev behind their tests during the freeze
This task closes when wave 3 actually cuts the stacked release

implementationNotes: User ruling recorded on opum-agent OPAG-65 and the campaign Story: wave 3's stacked release is lore 0.5.0, and quest ships 0.5.0 at the same time -- from that release on, the two CLIs move in lockstep at every stacked release, one number naming the pair. No change to this repo's plan beyond certainty of the number (the bump was already semantic: LCLI-359 breaking, LCLI-333 default backend). No action before wave 3; when wave 3 arrives, prepare CHANGELOG.md's [0.5.0] entry and any migration note (e.g. for LCLI-359's InitResult.backlog removal) as part of that release cut.

Release-prep landed (PR pending merge, branch chore/LCLI-release-prep-0.5.0): version bump to 0.5.0 across package.json/npm manifests/plugin.json, bun.lock regenerated, 3 Ladybug digest baselines refreshed, CHANGELOG.md folded into a [0.5.0] section with the lockstep note and LCLI-359/LCLI-434 marked BREAKING. Deliberately did not touch README's 'Published as/Status: released' banner since 0.4.6 is still the actually-published version -- that lands with the real tag+publish step, not this prep PR. Dev only; no tag/promote/publish yet, per opum-agent's explicit instruction. This task stays open until the actual cut.

Wave 3 cut lore 0.5.0. Tag v0.5.0 at 66aef64, promoted 2026-09-08 via PR #622 (dev to main fast-forward). Published via Release run 34238810885 (npm OIDC trusted publishing) after an earlier mistaken run (34237851380) tagged a stale local main ref and correctly no-op'd against 0.4.3 -- see docs/reference/lore-cli-release-truth.md for the full timeline. All 7 packages confirmed live at 0.5.0 as of 2026-09-08T14:49:18Z (lore-linux-arm64 was last to resolve, ~25min propagation lag -- filed LCLI-460 as the deferred follow-up). quest-cli published 0.5.0 in parallel and independently. Closing: wave 3 has actually cut.
